description: This file defines the App class in the Goteo application, extending Symfony's HttpKernel. It manages application-wide services, routing, request handling, error handling, and debug mode for the Goteo web application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class managing request lifecycle, routing, services, error handling, and debug mode for the Goteo PHP web application.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current Request object, creating it from globals if not already set.

methods.name: getServiceContainer
methods.description: Returns the service container, loading it from a PHP file if not already loaded.

methods.name: setServiceContainer
methods.description: Sets the service container to a specific instance.

methods.name: isService
methods.description: Checks if a service exists in the container.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a service from the container.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event via the event dispatcher service.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns the route collection, loading from a PHP file if not already set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the App, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug mode, affecting error display, logging, and profiling.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request, sends the response, and terminates the application.

methods.name: clearApp
methods.description: Resets the singleton instances and cached data.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the array of collected errors.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Custom error handler to log and display errors, collecting error info.
